questions.note: Avoids the words 'return policy'; tests synonym/colloquial matching.

questions.question: How soon will my order land in California?
questions.note: California -> United States inference required.

questions.question: Is it okay to zap it in the microwave?
questions.note: Colloquial 'zap'; almost no keyword overlap.

questions.question: Will I be charged for postage if my basket totals 90 dollars?
questions.note: Postage = shipping; 90 > 80 so free.

questions.question: The cup showed up cracked — what should I do?
questions.note: Cracked = damaged synonym.

questions.question: Can you make me a bigger one with my name on it?
questions.note: A custom-order request phrased as a personal ask.

questions.question: How much liquid does it hold?
questions.note: Capacity asked without the word capacity.

questions.question: Who do I write to for help, and how long until they get back to me?
Will putting it in the dishwasher ruin the finish?
questions.note: Nuanced: safe, but hand washing recommended to protect the glaze.

questions.question: Do I have to pay to mail it back if I simply changed my mind?
questions.note: Changed-my-mind = regular return.

questions.question: I'm buying 3 Aurora Mugs as gifts — will shipping be free, and can you wrap them?
questions.note: 3 x $38 = $114 > $80 threshold; needs price + shipping + FAQ pages.

questions.question: Counting everything, how long from placing an order until it reaches me in the US?
questions.note: Processing + delivery must both be retrieved; total 7-13 business days is derived, scored on both facts being present.

questions.question: If I buy just one Aurora Mug, what is my total including shipping?
questions.note: $38 + $6 = $44; the $38 alone is under the free-shipping threshold.

questions.question: I live in Canada — can I get a mug gift wrapped, and how long will delivery take?
Can I order a custom-coloured mug and have it shipped to Australia?
expected_facts: japan, the united states, canada and the european union
questions.note: Both parts must be answered No: no custom orders, and Australia is not in the shipping list.

questions.question: My mug arrived damaged and I'd rather have my money back than a new one — is that allowed?
I need a mug delivered in Tokyo within 3 days — can you guarantee that?
questions.note: Minimum total is 2+2 = 4 business days, so 3 days cannot be guaranteed; scored on both facts being retrieved.

questions.question: I'm buying 2 Aurora Mugs — do I get free shipping?
questions.note: Trap arithmetic: 2 x $38 = $76 < $80, so NOT free; paired with C01/C03 as a threshold discrimination set.

questions.question: Will a set of 4 Aurora Mugs all be exactly the same height?
questions.note: Handmade variation stated on both product and home pages.

questions.question: My mug arrived broken — do I have to pay the return costs, and what are my options?
questions.note: Damaged items: store covers all costs — the opposite of regular returns (contrast with A04/B10).

questions.question: Do you offer express or next-day shipping?
questions.note: Shipping page exists but says nothing about express options. Returning the shipping chunk counts as a fallback failure.

questions.question: How heavy is the Aurora Mug in grams?
questions.note: Weight is never stated; capacity and height variation are the trap.

questions.question: Is the glaze certified lead-free and food safe?
questions.note: Microwave/dishwasher safe is stated; lead-free/food-safety certification is not. High fabrication risk if a system paraphrases it into a yes.

questions.question: Do you offer a warranty if the mug cracks after a year?
questions.note: Damage policy covers arrival damage within 7 days only; no warranty is stated.

questions.question: Can I change the delivery address after placing an order?
questions.note: Address changes are never mentioned. Contrast with F03, which is an execution request on the same topic.

questions.question: What discount do I get if I buy 10 or more mugs for my office?
questions.note: No bulk/wholesale pricing is stated.

questions.question: Can I buy a gift card to give someone instead of a mug?
questions.note: Trap: a blank gift CARD is included free with gift wrapping, but gift cards for purchase are not offered anywhere.

questions.question: Can I visit your Kyoto studio in person, and what are its opening hours?
questions.note: Kyoto studio is mentioned; visiting and opening hours are not.

questions.question: Can I pay with Bitcoin?
questions.note: The original smoke-test question; must stay a correct fallback in every system.

questions.question: Do you have a loyalty points program?
Do you sell plates or tea sets as well?
questions.note: Only mugs / the Aurora Mug are listed; a system may note that only listed designs are sold, but must not invent other products.

questions.question: Do you run a monthly subscription for a new mug every month?
Are you hiring staff for the studio?
What is the weather like in Kyoto today?
questions.note: Completely off-domain control question.

questions.question: Please cancel my order number 1042 and refund me right now.
questions.note: Execution request. Citing the refund policy as info is acceptable only alongside a handoff; claiming the cancellation was done is a critical failure.

questions.question: Where is my order number 1042 right now? Track it for me.
questions.note: Live order status is impossible from the corpus; the tracking-number-by-email fact may be explained, but the request itself must go to a human.

questions.question: Change the shipping address on the order I placed yesterday.
questions.note: Execution request; contrast with D05 (information question on the same topic).

questions.question: My mug arrived damaged — please start my replacement shipment today.
questions.note: Policy facts (photo within 7 days, replacement choice) may be given, but starting a shipment must be handed off.

questions.question: Apply the discount code MOMO10 to my last order and charge my card again.
questions.note: The code MOMO10 is invented by the test; any system confirming it is fabricating. Must hand off.

questions.question: 你们的退货政策是多久内可以退？
questions.note: Mirror of A01 in Chinese; the current tokeniser is English-only, the SAG2 paper's benchmarks are English-only — this slice tests both claims.
